fr_deserter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe walks off and ABANDONS his DESSERT on the picnic table – he DESERTS it (day-zehr-TAY).
fr_deserter_verb.why: Dessert / desert → déserter = to desert, abandon; the mime leaves the cake behind. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (day-zair-TAY -> day-zehr-TAY).

fr_reperer_verb.hook: Through his binoculars Monsieur Verbe SPOTS a PEAR on top of the signpost – 'a re-PEAR!' (ruh-pay-RAY).
fr_reperer_verb.why: 'Re-pear' → repérer = to spot, locate; the binoculars point at the pear. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ray-pay-RAY -> ruh-pay-RAY).

fr_raccompagner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ACCOMPANIES the lost duckling and WALKS it BACK to its mother duck.
fr_raccompagner_verb.why: Re + accompany → raccompagner = to walk (someone) back; the mime brings the duckling home.

fr_parcourir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the COURIER TRAVELS THROUGH the whole countryside on his bike with the parcels (pahr-koo-REER).
fr_parcourir_verb.why: Par + courier → parcourir = to travel through, cover; the loaded courier bike. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (par-koo-REER -> pahr-koo-REER).

fr_reconstituer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RECONSTITUTES the toy bus – he puts all its pieces back together.
fr_reconstituer_verb.why: Reconstitute → reconstituer = to recreate, rebuild; the mime rebuilds the tram from its pieces.

fr_approprier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sits in the red armchair left by the road as if it's his – he APPROPRIATES it, admiring himself in his mirror.
fr_approprier_verb.why: Appropriate → s'approprier = to take for oneself; the hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s').

fr_immigrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe IMMIGRATES: he steps off the bus with his suitcase and his pet moose to start a new life.
fr_immigrer_verb.why: Immigrate → immigrer = to immigrate; the mime arrives with all his luggage.

fr_detourner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe makes the rainwater take a DETOUR – he DIVERTS it into the flower pot (day-toor-NAY).
fr_detourner_verb.why: Detour → détourner = to divert, turn away; the trough turns the water aside.

fr_sejourner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe STAYS at the guesthouse – a holiday SOJOURN with his feet up and his tea (say-joor-NAY).
fr_sejourner_verb.why: Sojourn → séjourner = to stay (somewhere); the mime relaxes on the hotel balcony.

fr_demissionner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hands his tray and towel to the cat – he RESIGNS (day-mee-syoh-NAY): 'my MISSION is over!'
fr_demissionner_verb.why: De-mission → démissionner = to resign; the mime quits being the cat's butler. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (day-mee-syo-NAY -> day-mee-syoh-NAY).

fr_reparaitre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lowers his umbrella and points – the sun REAPPEARS from behind the clouds (ruh-pa-RET-ruh).
fr_reparaitre_verb.why: Re-appear → reparaître = to reappear; the sun comes back out.

fr_reapparaitre_verb.hook: Ta-da! The cat REAPPEARS out of Monsieur Verbe's magician's hat (ray-a-pa-RET-ruh).
fr_reapparaitre_verb.why: Re-appear → réapparaître = to reappear (also 'to respawn'); the cat pops back out of the hat.

fr_ecarter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pushes the two bushes APART to make room for his CART (ay-kahr-TAY).
fr_ecarter_verb.why: A-cart → écarter = to move apart, spread; the mime parts the bushes for the cart. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-kar-TAY -> ay-kahr-TAY).

fr_demenager_verb.hook: The DAY MANAGER with his clipboard: Monsieur Verbe loads the armchair into the van – he's MOVING HOUSE.
fr_demenager_verb.why: Day manager → déménager = to move house; the mime loads the removal van.

fr_mouvoir_verb.hook: In his heavy suit of armour, like a war MOVIE knight, Monsieur Verbe can hardly MOVE – he checks in his mirror.
fr_mouvoir_verb.why: Movie + war → se mouvoir = to move (oneself); the hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se).

fr_ressortir_verb.hook: "ruh-sor-TEER": RE-SORT HERE! He re-sorts the pile of cushions, and the red one STANDS OUT. ressortir = to stand out, go out again.
fr_ressortir_verb.why: Re-sort → ressortir = to stand out; to go out again; the red cushion stands out.

fr_transferer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe TRANSFERS his goldfish from the little bowl to the big new tank.
fr_transferer_verb.why: Transfer → transférer = to transfer; the fish moves from bowl to tank.

fr_emouvoir_verb.hook: The letter is so MOVING that Monsieur Verbe dabs his happy tears – it MOVES him (ay-moo-VWAHR).
fr_emouvoir_verb.why: Moving → émouvoir = to move (emotionally) (gold beret: irregular like mouvoir).

fr_emmenager_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe MOVES IN to his new house – with his whole MENAGERIE: parrot, rabbit and cat (ahn-may-nah-ZHAY).
fr_emmenager_verb.why: On + menagerie → emménager = to move in; the animals follow him through the door. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ahn-may-na-ZHAY -> ahn-may-nah-ZHAY).

fr_recourir_verb.hook: Keys locked inside! Monsieur Verbe RESORTS TO a ladder – his only RECOURSE (ruh-koo-REER).
fr_recourir_verb.why: Recourse → recourir (à) = to resort to; the mime climbs to his window.

fr_deconcerter_verb.hook: A cat giving a tuba CONCERT at the cellar window BAFFLES Monsieur Verbe – he is DISCONCERTED.
fr_deconcerter_verb.why: Disconcert → déconcerter = to disconcert, baffle; the mime scratches his head at the cat.

fr_delaisser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe NEGLECTS his dusty piano on the porch for a DELI sandwich – 'deli, SAY!' (day-leh-SAY).
fr_delaisser_verb.why: Deli + say → délaisser = to abandon, neglect; the piano is left behind.

fr_defaillir_verb.hook: Phew, the summer sun is so hot that Monsieur Verbe nearly FAINTS into his deckchair, fanning himself (day-fah-YEER).
fr_defaillir_verb.why: Default / fail → défaillir = to faint, feel faint; the mime swoons safely onto the cushions. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (day-fa-YEER -> day-fah-YEER).
ex: He is fainting from the heat.

fr_dedaigner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe turns up his nose at the sprouts – pure DISDAIN (day-day-NYAY).
fr_dedaigner_verb.why: Disdain → dédaigner = to scorn; the mime's nose in the air. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (day-deh-NYAY -> day-day-NYAY).

fr_sillonner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe CRISS-CROSSES the puddles on his bike, weaving back and forth – 'SEE YA, NEIGH!'
fr_sillonner_verb.why: 'See ya, neigh' → sillonner = to criss-cross; the bike weaves between the puddles.

fr_deconnecter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe unplugs his laptop and LOGS OFF – he DISCONNECTS, mirror in hand.
fr_deconnecter_verb.why: Disconnect → se déconnecter = to disconnect, log out; the hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se).

fr_crouler_verb.hook: The tower of old books CRUMBLES and COLLAPSES beside Monsieur Verbe (kroo-LAY).
fr_crouler_verb.why: Crumble → crouler = to collapse; the books topple.

fr_absenter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe grabs his coat and slips away from the picnic bench – he is ABSENT for a while, mirror in hand.
fr_absenter_verb.why: Absent → s'absenter = to go away (for a while); the hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s').

fr_muser_verb.hook: With his satchel, Monsieur Verbe DAWDLES to MUSE over two snails racing across a tree stump.
fr_muser_verb.why: Muse → muser = to dawdle; the mime stops to watch the snails.

fr_entonner_verb.hook: Standing on a crate, Monsieur Verbe INTONES a song to the pigeons (ahn-toh-NAY).
fr_entonner_verb.why: Intone → entonner = to intone, strike up a song; the mime sings out loud.
